facts: Perimeter $=$ the sum of every side on the **outside** of the figure.

For figures made from horizontal and vertical sides, the lengths going right add to the same total as those going left, and the lengths going up add to the same total as those going down. Use these matching totals to find missing sides.
Internal dividing lines are **not** part of the perimeter.
steps: Fill in every missing side length using the matching totals.
Add all the side lengths around the outside.
Write the answer with the correct unit.

workedExamples.solution_text:
Add every side around the outside.

$\begin{aligned}P&=9+3+5+4+4+7\\&=32\mathrm{\ cm}\end{aligned}$

Convert the metre measurements to centimetres.

$1.2\mathrm{\ m}=120\mathrm{\ cm}$

$0.8\mathrm{\ m}=80\mathrm{\ cm}$

$\begin{aligned}\text{Notch width}&=120-30-50\\&=40\mathrm{\ cm}\end{aligned}$

[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=5mm,y=5mm,draw=black,every node/.style={text=black,font=\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont}]
\draw (0,0)--(3,0)--(3,4)--(7,4)--(7,0)--(12,0)--(12,8)--(0,8)--cycle;
\path (1.5,0) node[below] {$30\mathrm{\ cm}$} (3,2) node[left] {$40\mathrm{\ cm}$} (5,4) node[above] {$40\mathrm{\ cm}$} (7,2) node[right] {$40\mathrm{\ cm}$} (9.5,0) node[below] {$50\mathrm{\ cm}$} (12,4) node[right] {$80\mathrm{\ cm}$} (6,8) node[above] {$120\mathrm{\ cm}$} (0,4) node[left] {$80\mathrm{\ cm}$};
\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

$\begin{aligned}P&=30+40+40+40+50+80+120+80\\&=480\mathrm{\ cm}\end{aligned}$

The bottom contributes three square sides and the top contributes one. The exposed horizontal ledges total two square sides, and the vertical boundary totals six.

$\begin{aligned}\text{Number of exposed square sides}&=3+1+2+6\\&=12\end{aligned}$

The dashed joins are inside the figure.

$\begin{aligned}P&=12\times7\\&=84\mathrm{\ cm}\end{aligned}$

development.solution_text:
The staircase pushes out to a rectangle $18\text{ cm}$ by $14\text{ cm}$.
$P=2\times(18+14)$
$=2\times32$
$=64\text{ cm}$

mastery.solution_text:
Working around the outside, the boundary is made of $12$ square sides.
$P=12\times9$
$=108\text{ cm}$
